title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: msg_inbox_post_respond uses static buffer (race condition)
description: msg_inbox_post_respond at coap_server.c:311 uses static uint8_t resp_buf[CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE]. A static buffer in the response path is unsafe for reentrant CoAP processing (multiple concurrent requests). CoAP stack can process multiple requests simultaneously.
